inlines.v: A'CHOR, noun [Gr., sordes capitis.] 1. The scald head, a disease forming scaly eruptions, supposed to be a critical evacuation of acrimonious humors; a species of herpes. 2. In mythology, the God of flies, said to have been worshipped by the Cyreneans, to avoid being vexed by those insects.
